name: Electronic Keyboard (61 Keys)
summary: Original 61-key electronic keyboard on an X-frame stand with an open music rest.
description: Brand-neutral digital keyboard for store S15, with notched white keys, raised black keys, blank display, abstract controls and speaker ribs. Static visual asset.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and shared procedural materials; no external assets or text.

display.origin: Floor centre of the complete stand footprint

accuracy_notes: Measured exported envelope includes stand feet and music rest; the keyboard chassis is approximately 1.0 by 0.4 m. C2-C7 inclusive with five groups of two and three black keys. Static geometry: no sound, key actuation or stand-folding behavior. Physical devices and complete S15 mall integration have not been tested.
